title: Toward Greater Autonomy in Materials Discovery Agents: Unifying Planning, Physics, and Scientists
abstract: arXiv:2506.05616v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We aim at designing language agents with greater autonomy for crystal materials discovery. While most of existing studies restrict the agents to perform specific tasks within predefined workflows, we aim to automate workflow planning given high-level goals and scientist intuition. To this end, we propose Materials Agent unifying Planning, Physics, and Scientists, known as MAPPS. MAPPS consists of a Workflow Planner, a Tool Code Generator, and a Scientific Mediator. The Workflow Planner uses large language models (LLMs) to generate structured and multi-step workflows. The Tool Code Generator synthesizes executable Python code for various tasks, including invoking a force field foundation model that encodes physics. The Scientific Mediator coordinates communications, facilitates scientist feedback, and ensures robustness through error reflection and recovery. translated_title: 迈向材料发现智能体的更大自主性：统一规划、物理与科学家
translated_abstract: arXiv:2506.05616v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们旨在设计具有更大自主性的语言智能体，用于晶体材料发现。虽然大多数现有研究将智能体限制在预定义工作流中执行特定任务，但我们旨在根据高层次目标和科学家直觉实现工作流规划的自动化。为此，我们提出了材料智能体，统一规划、物理与科学家，称为MAPPS。MAPPS由工作流规划器、工具代码生成器和科学调解器组成。工作流规划器使用大型语言模型（LLMs）生成结构化的多步骤工作流。工具代码生成器为各种任务合成可执行的Python代码，包括调用编码物理的力场基础模型。科学调解器协调通信，促进科学家反馈，并通过错误反思和恢复确保鲁棒性。通过统一规划、物理与科学家，MAPPS实现了灵活且可靠的材料发现流程。
tldr: MAPPS通过统一工作流规划、物理模型和科学家反馈，使材料发现智能体能够根据高层目标自动生成并执行灵活的工作流，从而实现更大的自主性。
en_tdlr: MAPPS enables greater autonomy in materials discovery agents by unifying workflow planning, physics-based models, and scientist feedback to automatically generate and execute flexible workflows from high-level goals.
